page.overview:
Who is Evil Ryu?

Evil Ryu first appeared Street Fighter Alpha 2 simply as a palette swap of his normal counterpart wearing a black or dark purple gi; in his gaming debut, the Alpha series also gives him a black headband. His skin and hair also featured a slightly dark shade. In these games, his voice is no different from regular Ryu. From the SNK vs. Capcom series onward, his eyes have been depicted with red irises, although some games have his eyes glow entirely red with a snarling face. His voice now becomes more deeper and darker with rage and hatred.

Like Akuma, Evil Ryu has a signature kanji that appears when he performs the Shun Goku Satsu; in Street Fighter Alpha 3 and Capcom vs. SNK 2, the kanji is , though it only appears in his endings and Super Combo Finishes. In early appearances, however, it was the same as Akuma's.

In Super Street Fighter IV: Arcade Edition, his design was given an update; he takes on a much more menacing and powerful appearance, with traits taken directly from Akuma. He now has fangs, his eyes glow brightly, his gi, gloves, and headband are torn, and his hair is spiked upwards with a reddish tint. His voice is also more demonic sounding, and he also constantly emits a dark red aura during fights.

Most notable of all is a gaping hole burned into his chest, with a similar scar on his back that bears a glowing kanji. The scar resembles the effects of being hit up close with Oni's Meido Gohado, and could also be a reference to a scene in the Ryu Final manga, in which Akuma punches clean through Ryu’s chest in their final battle and almost defeats him. In Ryu's guest appearance in Asura's Wrath, it is Asura who gives him the scar after launching him into the moon from Earth and attempting to impale him with his fist. The scar disappears after he returns to normal.
